routines.name: intro
steps: centered_text(VAR_SID_intro_welcome) ; wait(20) ; melody([C6, B5, C6, N0, N0, N0, N0, N0, N0, N0, As5])

routines.name: move_right
steps: stop_loop_anim() ; erase_right(25) ; beep(G4) ; stop_room_anim() ; icon_subr(ICN_ui_input) ; icon_add(ICN_ui_input_arrow_r)

routines.name: move_left
steps: stop_loop_anim() ; erase_left(25) ; beep(G4) ; stop_room_anim() ; icon_subr(ICN_ui_input) ; icon_add(ICN_ui_input_arrow_l)

routines.name: move_up
steps: stop_loop_anim() ; erase_top(25) ; beep(G4) ; stop_room_anim() ; icon_subr(ICN_ui_input) ; icon_add(ICN_ui_input_stairs_u)

routines.name: move_down
steps: stop_loop_anim() ; erase_bottom(25) ; beep(G5) ; stop_room_anim() ; icon_subr(ICN_ui_input) ; icon_add(ICN_ui_input_stairs_d)

routines.name: search_beginning
steps: draw_house() ; stop_room_anim() ; icon_sub(VAR_ICN_search_item) ; icon_sub(ICN_ui_input_search) ; text(SID_searching_00) ; beep(C6)

routines.name: search_ending
steps: draw_house() ; icon_sub(VAR_ICN_search_item) ; text(SID_searching_04) ; wait(1) ; beep(D5) ; inc_stat(Searches)

routines.name: search_unlocked
steps: draw_house() ; stop_room_anim() ; icon_sub(VAR_ICN_search_item) ; icon_sub(VAR_ICN_lock) ; icon_sub(ICN_ui_input_search) ; text(SID_searching_00) ; beep(C5)
icon_add(VAR_ICN_lock) ; icon_sub(VAR_ICN_key) ; wait(1) ; melody([C4, Ds4, Fs4, A4, C5])

routines.name: moidad
steps: clear() ; stop_room_anim() ; icon_add(ICN_walls) ; icon_add(VAR_ICN_monsta_spot) ; icon_add(VAR_ICN_monsta) ; play_loop_anim(RT_Game_loop_monsta_rip_0, 20)

clear() ; icon_add(ICN_monsta_hand) ; icon_add(ICN_monsta_blood) ; play_loop_anim(RT_Game_loop_monsta_rip_1, 20) ; melody([B3, B5, As3, As5, A3, A5, Gs3, Gs5, G3, G5, Fs3, Fs5, F3, F5, E3, E5, ;         Ds3, Ds5, D3, D5, Cs3, Cs5])

routines.name: loop_monsta_rip_0
steps: icon_add(VAR_ICN_monsta) ; icon_add(ICN_monsta_hand) ; melody([C6, Fs5, E5, C5])

routines.name: show_unlock
steps: icon_sub(VAR_ICN_lock) ; icon_sub(VAR_ICN_key) ; wait(1) ; melody([C4, Ds4, Fs4, A4, C5])

routines.name: found_nothing
steps: draw_house() ; centered_text(SID_nothing) ; melody([Fs5, Fs4, Fs3]) ; wait(20)

routines.name: found_nothing_search_tip
steps: stop_room_anim() ; stop_loop_anim() ; clear() ; melody([F4, A5, C6]) ; icon_add(ICN_walls) ; wait(20)

routines.name: found_key
steps: draw_house() ; centered_text(SID_hidden_key) ; melody([Fs5, Ds5, C5, A4, C5, Ds5, Fs5, A5]) ; icon_add(ICN_ui_key)

routines.name: found_code
steps: centered_text(SID_hidden_code) ; melody([Fs5, Ds5, C5, A4, C5, Ds5, Fs5, A5])

routines.name: found_code_part
steps: centered_text(SID_code_part) ; melody([As4, C5, Ds5, F5, As5])

routines.name: found_latch
steps: draw_house() ; centered_text(SID_hidden_latch) ; melody([Fs5, Ds5, C5, A4, C5, Ds5, Fs5, A5]) ; erase_ui_input()
icon_reveal(VAR_ICN_hidden_passage, 20) ; melody([C4, Ds4, Fs4, A4, C5])

routines.name: found_spider
steps: draw_house() ; centered_text(SID_spider_ran) ; melody([As3, As4, As5]) ; wait(30)

routines.name: found_crown_button_beginning_0
steps: erase_ui_input() ; icon_add(VAR_ICN_search_item) ; centered_text(SID_crown_button) ; melody([E5, F5]) ; wait(20)

routines.name: found_crown_button_pushing_all
steps: erase_border(20, ICN_walls) ; melody([C3, C4, C5, C6])
icon_add(ICN_crown) ; melody([D4, F4, G4, As4, D5, G5, F5, G5, D5, F5, G5, As5])
draw_house() ; clear_text() ; icon_sub(ICN_ui_crown) ; wait(1) ; melody([A3, A4, A5])
melody([Ds4, Ds4, A4]) ; speak(RT_Game_speak_loop, ICN_ui_friend_talk_all, SID_lets_escape)

routines.name: loop_crown_warp_0
steps: clear() ; icon_add(ICN_hyper) ; icon_add(ICN_ui_friend_face_all) ; melody([As3, As4, As5, As3, As4, As5])

routines.name: loop_crown_warp_1
steps: clear() ; icon_add(ICN_hyper) ; icon_add(ICN_ui_friend_face_all) ; melody([B3, B4, B5, B3, B4, B5])

routines.name: loop_crown_warp_2
steps: clear() ; icon_add(ICN_hyper) ; icon_add(ICN_ui_friend_face_all) ; melody([C4, C5, C6, C4, C5, C6])

routines.name: friend_crown_button_release
steps: draw_house() ; melody([Ds4, Ds4, A4]) ; icon_add(VAR_ICN_friend_talk) ; wait(2)

routines.name: ghost_start
steps: draw_house() ; icon_add(ICN_ghost_cs_0) ; melody([A3, Gs3, N0, G3]) ; wait(10)

routines.name: ghost_end
steps: draw_house() ; melody([A5, Gs5, N0, G5, N0, A4, Gs4, N0, G4, N0, A3, Gs3, N0, G3])

routines.name: rescue_beginning
steps: icon_subr(ICN_ui_input) ; melody([D4, F4, G4, As4, D5, G5, F5, G5, D5, F5, G5, As5])
centered_text(VAR_SID_rescued) ; icon_sub(VAR_ICN_search_item) ; icon_add(VAR_ICN_friend_face) ; melody([F5, A5, C6, N0, A5, N0, C6])

routines.name: rescue_then_hint
steps: clear() ; melody([F4, A5, C6]) ; icon_add(ICN_walls) ; icon_add(VAR_ICN_friend_face) ; wait(20)

routines.name: rescue_then_gift
steps: icon_add(VAR_ICN_friend_face) ; icon_add(VAR_ICN_hint_item) ; give_next_gift() ; melody([Fs5, Ds5, C5, A4, C5, Ds5, Fs5, A5])

routines.name: escape
steps: stop_loop_anim() ; stop_room_anim() ; clear() ; icon_add(ICN_intro) ; icon_add(VAR_ICN_escape_spider) ; icon_add(ICN_intro_monsta_0) ; melody([C3, Ds3, F3, C4, Ds4, F4, C5, Ds5, F5, C6]) ; wait(20)
melody([C3, D3, Ds3, D3, C3, D3, Ds3, D3, C3, D3, Ds3, D3, C3, D3, Ds3, D3]) ; wait(15) ; centered_text(SID_escaped)
melody([D3, Ds3, F3, Ds3, D3, Ds3, F3, Ds3, D3, Ds3, F3, Ds3, D3, Ds3, F3, Ds3]) ; wait(15)
melody([G3, A3, As3, A3, G3, A3, As3, A3, G3, A3, As3, A3, G3, A3, As3, A3]) ; wait(15)
melody([C4, N0, N0, A3, N0, N0, As3, N0, N0, C4, N0, N0, As3])
